newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - July 29.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - July 29.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Charles Konan Banny, governor of the Central Bank of West African States (BCEAO), says Guinea and even Anglophone Ghana would be welcome as members of the Franc Zone.
- Boiler explosion kills a worker at Nestle's Nescafe factory in Abidjan.

- The bridge that Bouygues is to build over the lagoon in Abidjan, between the districts of Marcory and Riviera, will cost between 50 and 60 billion CFA francs ($80-96 million). The World Bank's International Finance Corporation may part fund it.

- Prime Minister Daniel Kablan Duncan tells a seminar that public finances must be made more rigorous and less bureaucratic. He says internal debts, which had amounted to 288 billion CFA francs ($465 million), had been paid in full.
